show.description: After sacrificing his identity and freedom for a woman who only loved his wealth, a mysterious billionaire returns from prison to rebuild his life in anonymity. When he rescues a fearless single mother and her daughter from a powerful enemy, he finds the emotional bond he has long been denied. But as his past resurfaces and betrayal stands exposed, love, revenge, and justice collide in a grand revelation that changes every life forever.
